opening: The crew has arrived. Choose a hauling route.
scout_arrived: A scout appeared beside a route.
scout_caught: The guard intercepted the scout. No report escaped.
delivery_seen: The scout witnessed a real delivery.
council: The council is considering how to handle the scout.
report_escaped: The scout escaped with its observations.
empty_report: The scout returned without useful intelligence.
raid_approaching: Attackers are approaching the reported route.
no_target: The enemy has no observed target.
raid_blocked: The guard repelled the attack and recovered supplies.
raid_empty_lane: The attackers struck an empty route.
raid_hit: The attack cost cargo and damaged the supply cart.
won: Expedition complete! The cart survived six cycles. Start a new expedition to play again.
lost: The supply cart was destroyed. The expedition is over.
vote_capture: Capture passed 2–1. The guard is moving to intercept.
vote_deceive: Deception passed 2–1. False cargo will be shown to the scout.
